## Scope

InTest deliberately does not do some things. Before opening, worth checking §2 (non-goals) and
§19 (deliberately not built) of the design spec — several plausible features were considered
and rejected with reasons recorded, and if you disagree with one of those reasons, saying which
one makes for a much sharper discussion.
